decision: Freeze original English-v6 scoring semantics with the shorter-reason output instruction for held-out diagnostic validation.

basis.semantic_expansion_result: No consistent gain across targeted checks and repeat stability; do not retain longer rules merely because they were proposed.
basis.format_result: No format-invalid outputs observed in completed r1/r2 calls; original scoring rules are preserved exactly.

remaining_format_probe: Four paired format-only development calls are still finishing. They will be reported, but this freeze is committed before their results; no subsequent wording changes based on them or the holdout.
known_limitations: R5 partial-loop effects remain difficult despite visible later evidence.
R7 attempted-answer versus intermediate-step boundary is unstable on one long repeated trajectory.
R2 initial retrieval versus global coverage judgments remain variable.
